L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: SDA and SCL both HIGH in bus-free state
L16: Open-drain (or open-collector) outputs on SDA and SCL for Sm/Fm/Fm+/Hs modes (push-pull only for UFm)
L16: Data on SDA stable while SCL HIGH; SDA changes only while SCL LOW (except for START / STOP / repeated START)
L16: START condition: SDA HIGH→LOW while SCL HIGH
L16: STOP condition: SDA LOW→HIGH while SCL HIGH
L16: Every byte is 8 bits + 1 ACK = 9 SCL clock pulses
L16: Receiver pulls SDA LOW on 9th SCL pulse to ACK
L16: MSB-first byte ordering
L16: Master generates all clock pulses including the 9th ACK pulse
L16: In multi-master systems: arbitration on SDA while SCL HIGH; loser turns off SDA driver immediately
L16: In multi-master systems: SCL synchronization via wired-AND (LOW dominates)
L16: Input levels: VIL ≤ 0.3 VDD, VIH ≥ 0.7 VDD (legacy fixed 1.5/3.0 V acceptable for backward compatibility)
L16: Bus capacitance Cb ≤ per-mode maximum (400 pF Sm/Fm, 550 pF Fm+, 100/400 pF Hs)
